title: validateApp requires owner; apps pass team from package.json (libs inlined, single repo)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching package.json team. Assumptions: owner passed as literal matching package.json team (bundler can't read package.json); library lives in mono libs/ and is inlined, so no platformkit release needed. PR #1 merged, CI+CD green.
